scope: capacity eligibility, assignment, claim ownership, worker authority, retry, cancellation, recovery, and physical release
closure_rule: Every entry must be protected, disabled, or deleted before global activation.

entries.current_mutation: Creates a queued public trial and derives mutable requires_caps; batch fan-out reaches the same route.
entries.required_replacement: One trusted submission procedure must atomically create the public projection, seal normalized requirements, and create a fresh pending-unassigned protected attempt identity.

entries.current_mutation: Writes requires_caps and later backfills lifecycle_authority_id directly on the public trial row.
entries.current_authority: candidate control-plane and trusted migration utilities
entries.required_replacement: Requirements become immutable protected input; an authorized unclaimed requirement migration must fence the old assignment and create a new digest/attempt generation.

entries.current_mutation: Sets or clears trials.autoscaler_pool_name for flexible queued work.
entries.required_replacement: Disable this writer and project only the current protected assignment created by an accepted placement allowance CAS.

entries.current_mutation: Creates and revokes broad worker bearer tokens not bound to protected subject, shape, intent, job, worker incarnation, or admission epoch.
entries.required_replacement: Fence legacy issuance; only the trusted bootstrap exchange may issue a hash-bound, expiry-bounded worker credential for an active protected authorization.

entries.current_mutation: Creates an active worker from a broad worker:report token and caller-provided capabilities/concurrency/pool.
entries.required_replacement: Route fleet workers through the protected bootstrap/job/shape exchange; retain legacy registration only behind an expiring compatibility writer.

entries.current_mutation: Updates worker last_seen_at and status directly.
entries.required_replacement: Authenticate the exact protected worker incarnation; heartbeat may refresh liveness but cannot restore claimability or clear drain/revocation.

entries.current_mutation: Selects an eligible queued public trial, flips family state, and writes claimed worker ownership without protected allowance or concurrency-lease authority.
entries.required_replacement: Candidate code may propose only; the trusted SERIALIZABLE claim procedure must validate the current protected assignment, worker authorization, sealed requirements, family/retry/team gates, and atomically allocate one concurrency lease.

entries.current_mutation: Refreshes a claimed trial pre-start heartbeat by public worker_id.
entries.required_replacement: Require exact protected claim, worker incarnation, completion capability, and claim epoch; retain the public timestamp as projection only.

entries.current_mutation: Moves claimed to queued, clears worker_id, adjusts attempts, and sets retry time before protected cessation proof.
entries.required_replacement: Move the protected claim to retry-pending, retain the charged lease, and create a fresh attempt only after scoped cessation or ownership-verified infrastructure loss.

entries.current_mutation: Writes running/succeeded/failed/cancelled, result, timestamps, and family progression using only public worker_id fencing.
entries.required_replacement: Use claim-scoped start/heartbeat/result/terminal procedures; terminal workload projection must not release concurrency until the exact protected completion transition closes it.

entries.current_mutation: Immediately marks queued, claimed, or running public trials cancelled and finished.
entries.required_replacement: Cancel unclaimed protected attempts terminally; move live claims to cancel-pending and retain their concurrency lease until scoped cessation evidence arrives.

entries.current_mutation: Cancels remaining queued family trials directly after skip or abort decisions.
entries.required_replacement: Invoke a protected family cancellation transaction for every current unclaimed attempt; any live member follows cancel-pending semantics.

entries.current_mutation: Marks a batch and all queued/claimed/running public trials cancelled in one candidate-schema transaction.
entries.required_replacement: Coordinate a protected batch cancellation for each attempt and project results only after protected unclaimed-terminal or live cancel-pending transitions commit.

entries.current_mutation: Directly cancels all in-flight trials when recorded provider cost exceeds a hard batch budget.
entries.required_replacement: Use the same protected batch cancellation surface; budget authority may request cancellation but cannot release or reassign protected claims.

entries.current_mutation: Moves claimed/running trials back to queued and clears worker ownership based on heartbeat age or pre-start timeout.
entries.required_replacement: Fence the exact worker, move claims to retry-pending/unknown, and keep leases charged until trusted cessation or ownership-verified terminal-job evidence closes them.

entries.current_mutation: ORM-mutates stale running trials to failed and terminal based on activity heuristics.
entries.required_replacement: Request a protected completion/retry transition; heuristics alone cannot release the claim or authorize replacement.

entries.current_mutation: Multiple controllers set worker drain_state/status and infer release from public in-flight trials and local pool policy.
entries.current_authority: candidate control-plane autoscaler and GB10 lifecycle loops
entries.required_replacement: One protected admission epoch fences replacement claims first; physical release requires zero protected live leases plus executor-owned terminal evidence.

entries.current_mutation: Submits/cancels Slurm jobs, records job-to-worker identity, reconciles terminal state, and uses broad worker-token fingerprints.
entries.current_authority: pool-local controller and candidate control-plane admin API
entries.required_replacement: Pool executors accept only manager offers, register the bootstrap hash before submission, bind the returned job exactly, and publish terminal evidence; the environment guard alone fences credentials and claims.

entries.current_mutation: Claims a dev-instance destroy operation and tears down namespace/data without a protected capacity drain checkpoint.
entries.required_replacement: Reject new submissions, fence admission, terminalize unclaimed attempts, drain live claims, revoke generation credentials, and delete capacity resources only after protected claim and physical-release checkpoints complete.

entries.current_mutation: The active legacy claim/assignment/token paths collectively form the current single writer but have no explicit epoch or expiry.
entries.required_replacement: Mirror only exact pre-freeze authority into a unique expiring legacy-compatibility epoch; prohibit neutral moves, new workers after freeze, global allowance consumption, and survival past global activation.
